summary: Iter 228c verification — SetupWizard refactor (Basics/Cap/Trades/Generate step extraction) and RulesScheduleTab card extraction tested live. CRITICAL bug found: GenerateStep crashes with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading length)' because the parent's `stepCtx` object in SetupWizard.jsx (lines 609-634) does NOT pass the props the new extracted step components consume. Step body divs (data-testid='wizard-body-*') render for basics/cap/divisions/schedule/trades because the testid lives on the outer wrapper, but the inputs inside are bound to UNDEFINED state setters — so user edits do NOT propagate. Generate step refuses to render at all (scheduleWarnings is undefined → .length throws). RulesScheduleTab.tsx + 3 of 4 extracted cards (SalaryCap, SalaryRetention, ContractBuyouts) render correctly on their consumer tabs (verified via card headings on Salary Cap & Contracts tab and rules-schedule-tab/rules-schedule-trade-card testids on Transactions tab).

ui_bugs.issue: Runtime error: 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading length)' at GenerateStep (line 56 references scheduleWarnings.length). The parent's `stepCtx` object does NOT include scheduleWarnings, scheduleMode, busy, generateSchedule, capEnabled, capAmount, retentionEnabled, retentionSlots, retentionMaxPct, or tradeDeadlineWeek — all consumed by GenerateStep. Step 6 (generate) is completely broken; the wizard cannot be completed.

stepCtx is missing: league, previousSeasonSuggestion, maxTeams/setMaxTeams, leagueFormat/setLeagueFormat, scoringFormat/setScoringFormat, rosterSpots/setRosterSpots, benchSpots/setBenchSpots, minorsSpots/setMinorsSpots, minorsEnabled/setMinorsEnabled. The outer div renders (testid passes), but all editable inputs are uncontrolled — user input does NOT update state and saveBasicsAndCap will persist stale/default values.

stepCtx is missing: capEnabled/setCapEnabled, capAmount/setCapAmount, retentionEnabled/setRetentionEnabled, retentionSlots/setRetentionSlots, retentionMaxPct/setRetentionMaxPct. Toggles and inputs render but state changes do not propagate to the parent.

stepCtx is missing: maxTeams, tradeReviewHours/setTradeReviewHours, tradeVetoCount/setTradeVetoCount, tradeDeadlineWeek/setTradeDeadlineWeek, tradeDeadlineDow/setTradeDeadlineDow, tradeDeadlineTime/setTradeDeadlineTime. Inputs render but are uncontrolled.

integration_issues.issue: Because the four extracted step components receive `undefined` for their setters, the user CANNOT change cap / basics / trade settings via the wizard. Clicking Next will save whatever defaults the parent useState initialized — silent data loss. Then on reaching step 6, the wizard crashes.

action_items: URGENT: Expand the `stepCtx = { ... }` object in /app/frontend/src/lovable/pages/commissioner/SetupWizard.jsx (around lines 609-634) to include every prop the extracted step components destructure. Concretely, add: league, previousSeasonSuggestion, rosterSpots/setRosterSpots, benchSpots/setBenchSpots, minorsSpots/setMinorsSpots, minorsEnabled/setMinorsEnabled, maxTeams/setMaxTeams, leagueFormat/setLeagueFormat, scoringFormat/setScoringFormat, capEnabled/setCapEnabled, capAmount/setCapAmount, retentionEnabled/setRetentionEnabled, retentionSlots/setRetentionSlots, retentionMaxPct/setRetentionMaxPct, tradeReviewHours/setTradeReviewHours, tradeVetoCount/setTradeVetoCount, tradeDeadlineWeek/setTradeDeadlineWeek, tradeDeadlineDow/setTradeDeadlineDow, tradeDeadlineTime/setTradeDeadlineTime, busy, generateSchedule, scheduleMode, scheduleWarnings.
Verify by re-running the wizard end-to-end after the fix — Generate step should render and Generate button should kick off /api/matchups/generate-schedule.
critical_code_review_comments: stepCtx in SetupWizard.jsx is severely under-populated after the refactor — this is a textbook 'props drilling regression' caused by extracting child components without auditing every destructured prop. Either pass `{...allState}` explicitly or move state ownership into a context provider so the four step components subscribe directly.

GenerateStep guards scheduleWarnings with `scheduleWarnings.length > 0` but should defensively default: `(scheduleWarnings || []).length > 0` — and the same for any array-valued prop in extracted components.

RulesScheduleTab.tsx re-exports the 4 cards from rules-cards/* via barrel-style `export { ... } from`. This works but couples the module to its consumers (CommissionerSettings/LeagueSetupTab/SalaryCapContractsTab). Consider importing the cards directly from rules-cards/* in those consumers in a follow-up to make the dependency graph explicit.

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE — In SetupWizard.jsx, the refactor extracted BasicsStep / CapStep / TradesStep / GenerateStep into separate files (228c) but the parent's `stepCtx` object (lines 609-634) was only updated for the previously-extracted DivisionsStep / ScheduleStep. The new step components destructure props from `ctx` that don't exist on stepCtx, so they receive `undefined`. REPRO: login as chriszarek → /commissioner/settings → 'Re-run Setup Wizard' → click Next four times to advance to the Generate step → React red-screen 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading length)' at GenerateStep line 56 (scheduleWarnings.length). MITIGATION: extend stepCtx to include every variable consumed by the four new step components; defensively default array props (e.g. `(scheduleWarnings || []).length`).
